description: Static 3D sphere reporting at a fixed point count
name: Static3D
geometry: closed Euclidean spheres on uint32 grid
coordinate_generation: uniform per axis; normal mean 0.5 standard deviation 0.125 clipped to [0,1]; skew has uniform x and independent exponential y,z with mean 0.1 clipped to [0,1]; nearest uint32 integer
radius_policy: same fraction of coordinate-domain width as 2D; no equal-answer-count adjustment

comparison_contract.measurement: single-core jobs; existing shared budgets and timeouts; three final repetitions

exceptions.esa_sprk_CHEATING_IDS_ONLY: SPRK (cheating): materialized IDs only; coordinate gathering and exact oracle outside query timing
